Licensed under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).* ## Introduction This vignette demonstrates how to reproduce and analyze occurrence data for **Glowworms** in Australia, using data from the [Atlas of Living Australia (ALA)](https://www.ala.org.au/). You'll learn how to download, clean, enrich, and visualize data with practical, reproducible R functions. ------------------------------------------------------------------------ This is the glimpse of your data : ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(dplyr) library(ecotourism) data("glowworms") glowworms |> glimpse() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Rows: 33 Columns: 15 $ obs_lat -30.48395, -30.36781, -30.29347, -30.29321, -30.25074, … $ obs_lon 152.8077, 152.8980, 152.7399, 152.7406, 153.0885, 152.8… $ date 2020-01-25, 2019-11-27, 2023-11-26, 2023-11-26, 2023-0… $ time "20:11:18", "00:00:00", "09:57:00", "09:56:00", "22:00:… $ year 2020, 2019, 2023, 2023, 2023, 2024, 2023, 2021, 2020, 2… $ month 1, 11, 11, 11, 1, 9, 11, 3, 9, 2, 2, 1, 5, 4, 11, 12, 1… $ day 25, 27, 26, 26, 28, 23, 24, 1, 22, 20, 20, 25, 5, 17, 2… $ hour 20, 0, 9, 9, 22, 22, 0, 19, 21, 8, 19, 8, 1, 19, 21, 17… $ weekday Saturday, Wednesday, Sunday, Sunday, Saturday, Monday, … $ dayofyear 25, 331, 330, 330, 28, 267, 328, 60, 266, 51, 51, 25, 1… $ sci_name "Arachnocampa", "Arachnocampa", "Arachnocampa", "Arachn… $ record_type "HUMAN_OBSERVATION", "HUMAN_OBSERVATION", "HUMAN_OBSERV… $ obs_state "New South Wales", "New South Wales", "New South Wales"… $ scientificName "Arachnocampa flava", "Arachnocampa flava", "Arachnocam… $ ws_id "947890-99999", "947890-99999", "947890-99999", "947890… ``` ::: ::: ## Visualization ### Spatial Distribution Map Distribution of Occurrence Glowworms Sightings in Australia ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(ggplot2) library(ggthemes) glowworms |> ggplot() + geom_sf(data = oz_lga) + geom_point(aes(x = obs_lon, y = obs_lat), color = "red") + theme_map() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](glowworms_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-3-1.png){width=576} ::: ::: ------------------------------------------------------------------------ ## Weekly, Monthly, and Yearly Trends Weekday Distribution of Glowworms Sightings ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} week_order <- c("Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday", "Sunday") glowworms |> ggplot(aes(x = factor(weekday, levels = week_order))) + geom_bar() + labs(x = "Weekday", y = "Number of Records") + theme_minimal() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](glowworms_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-4-1.png){width=576} ::: ::: Monthly Distribution of Glowworms Sightings ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(lubridate) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Attaching package: 'lubridate' ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` The following objects are masked from 'package:base': date, intersect, setdiff, union ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} glowworms |> dplyr::mutate(month = month(month, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE)) |> ggplot(aes(x = factor(month))) + geom_bar() + labs(x = "Month", y = "Number of Records") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](glowworms_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-5-1.png){width=576} ::: ::: Yearly Distribution of Glowworms Sightings ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} glowworms |> ggplot(aes(x = factor(year))) + geom_bar() + labs(x = "Year", y = "Number of Records") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](glowworms_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-6-1.png){width=576} ::: ::: ------------------------------------------------------------------------ We want to see if `glowworms` occurrences are related to precipitation on the same day from the weather dataset. Here’s a short R script that: 1. Joins `glowworms` with **weather_data** using `ws_id` and `date`. 2. Counts daily occurrences. 3. Plots precipitation vs number of `glowworms` sightings. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(ggbeeswarm) # Prepare glowworms occurrence counts per day glowworms_quarterly <- glowworms |> mutate(quarter = quarter(date)) |> group_by(year, quarter, ws_id) |> summarise(occurrence = n(), .groups = "drop") data("tourism_quarterly") tourism_region_sub <- tourism_region |> filter(ws_id %in% glowworms$ws_id) tourism_sub <- tourism_quarterly |> filter(region_id %in% tourism_region_sub$region_id) |> mutate(year = year(quarter), quarter = quarter(quarter)) |> select(year, quarter, purpose, trips, region_id) glowworms_regions <- glowworms_quarterly |> left_join(tourism_region_sub, by="ws_id") glowworms_tourism <- glowworms_regions |> left_join(tourism_sub, by=c("region_id", "year", "quarter")) # Simple scatter plot: precipitation vs glowworms occurrence ggplot(glowworms_tourism, aes(x = quarter, y = occurrence)) + geom_jitter(width=0.1) + stat_summary(colour="red", geom = "point", size=5) + labs( title = "Relationship between tourism and glowworms occurrence", x = "Quarter", y = "Occurrence (jittered)" ) + theme_minimal() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](glowworms_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-7-1.png){width=576} ::: :::
